accepted_design.name: COGNITIVE_PROCESS_BOUNDARY_DISPATCH
accepted_design.separation_rule: Keep semantic architecture dispatch separate from the opaque-symbol binder target so the harness can attribute failure to boundary semantics versus episode-local symbol binding.
repairs: All ten seed rows are METHOD_ONLY; counterfactual does not automatically mean SYNTHETIC_HARD_NEGATIVE.
Five causal minimal-pair families are ancestry-atomic and TRAIN-only in this seed.
Each of the five implementation classes appears exactly twice.
Model-visible prompts contain functional situations rather than transient current SHAs, progress values or temporary frontier facts.
Targets explicitly separate process_id, implementation_class, authority and packet/boundary.
Rows cannot mint canonical truth, direct effect authority, runtime credit or training credit.

causal_pairs: temporary working-state reconstruction <-> exact durable DB retrieval
exact DB retrieval <-> deterministic task admission
deterministic EffectGate/Journal authority <-> Claude Code bridge
Claude Code return reconciliation <-> model-specific J-Space causal research
J-Space causal research <-> ordinary grid planning

checks: exact row count 10 and family count 5
two-row counterfactual family integrity and shared ancestry
each causal pair must actually change process/class/authority/packet routing

research_return.training_rule: Teach cognitive-process boundary selection as an explicit factor before composing it with episode-local opaque-symbol routing.
research_return.architecture_implication: The small model should learn function-stable cognitive process competence independent of N or executor personality. Durable exact data remains database-backed; real effects remain deterministic; Claude Code bridge and model-specific J-Space research stay distinct.
research_return.harness_requirement: Score process_id, implementation_class, authority and packet/boundary separately. Add paired causal-flip and N/executor/layout invariance metrics before joint binder composition.
research_return.falsifier: If harmless changes to N, executor identity or presentation alter the selected implementation class, the model has learned topology or lexical shortcuts instead of cognitive-process identity.
research_return.next_composition_gate: Only after dispatch and binder are independently strong should a joint test require architecture decision -> independently randomized episode codebook -> opaque atom.

next_exact_actions: Run the linter against the exact branch seed and preserve its result as source-design evidence only.
Add validation and frozen holdout invariance families for N, executor identity, harmless serialization/layout and text-recurrence nuisance while keeping all five classes balanced.
Before any training admission, derive process/class bindings from the exact bound census/ABI bytes rather than trusting copied evaluator metadata.
After independent dispatch and binder gates pass, build a composition-only evaluation without allowing one task to leak labels into the other.
